title: Complex conditional
detail: The nested conditional logic makes the pattern generation harder to understand. Consider refactoring to simplify the logic.

title: Potential index out of bounds
detail: If `index` is the last character in the string, `index < (codepoint_count - 1)` will be false, and `index` will be incremented by 1. This could lead to an index out of bounds error if the subsequent character is also a ZWJ.
